content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I work with businesses to learn about their financial needs and match them with the right loan solutions. I’m able to help your business obtain a commercial loan, real estate loan, line of credit, Small Business Administration (SBA) loan, and more. As someone with years of experience in banking and credit analysis, I know what lenders are looking for in a loan applicant and enjoy working with customers like you, to guide you through the process.

A Little About Me

I’ve lived in southeastern Global my entire life and truly love my community. I currently reside in Stonington, CT with my husband and daughter. I’m a member of the Southeastern CT Women’s Network and actively attend business networking events.

I graduated in 2014 from Salve Regina University with a bachelor’s degree in Business Administration and a bachelor’s degree in Financial Management. I continued my education at Salve Regina University and graduated with my Master of Business Administration (MBA) degree in 2015.
